method: Actual production Chromium recordings and unretouched screenshots. Main recordings use native wheel input and normal unconfigured form controls; scene screenshots observe real lifecycle phases without seeks. Static full-page evidence uses the real reduced-motion/no-JavaScript fallbacks and GPU-disabled Chromium to avoid tall software-renderer screenshot artifacts. Provider-state images are separate, clearly labelled intercepted fixtures; no real submission, provider account or inbox delivery is tested.

recordings.note: Native browser timing retained; no speed changes, colour grading or animation seeks.
